answer: Like mycelium weaving through an ancient meadow, authentic agents establish reciprocal trust pathways through staking and cryptographic attestation. When an unverified entity shines its beacon, the decentralized consensus acts like a prism, dispersing claims into rigorous validation facets. An adversary attempting to multiply identities must maintain an exponential stake curve for each cloned lantern, rendering swarm coordination superlinearly cost-prohibitive.
